_comment: LoopStar GENERATIVE material pack (LP.6 / Phase ML.4). Genre-authentic DNA for the on-device 'Make it new' generator (LoopStarMaterialEngine). The Swift binary is a SKELETON (RULE #1): it ships a clamped tempo-heuristic fallback and reads THIS file at runtime for the real genre feel. Zero-rebuild to tune. Companion phrase pack: phrases/jazz/ (three verbatim public-domain heads, 1929-1930). Encoded from docs/idiom-research/genre-jazz-blues-classical.md GENRE 1; GM programs 0-based (the source-book lists them 1-based). Swing is intentionally high: the engine delays the off-beat eighth by swing * 0.25 beats, so 0.6 lands near the 2:1 triplet feel the source-book requires (section 8 trap 1 -- straight eighths at swing tempo is the number-one corny tell). Schema owner: LoopStarGenrePack.swift.
name: Jazz
blurb: Swing-era jazz: a brushed ride-and-hat pocket, rootless piano ninths punching the off-beats, an upright bass walking chromatic approaches, and a trumpet head on hard-swung eighths.

flavors.label: Ballad
flavors.blurb: Slow and rubato-ish: fat rootless ninths held under the melody, brushes, no chop.

flavors.label: Bebop Burner
flavors.blurb: Rhythm changes at speed: a chord every half bar and short comping stabs between them.

flavors.label: Modal Vamp
flavors.blurb: Two chords for sixteen bars, So What style: wide quartal voicings and space to blow.

flavors.label: Blues Head
flavors.blurb: The jazz twelve with the sharp-four diminished in bar six and a two-five turnaround home.

flavors.label: Minor Swing
flavors.blurb: Gypsy-leaning minor: half-diminished twos, minor sixes, and a hard chopped pompe that never drags.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: Jazz here runs swing-era to bebop: functional ii-V-I motion, chords voiced as sevenths and ninths, tritone and secondary-dominant substitution, chromatic approach from a half step above or below, and a turnaround every eight bars. Never a plain triad, never a modal flat-seven cadence. One or two chords a bar; dominants either resolve or deceive on purpose.
